Currently, established REITs and InvITs in India are already open to foreign investments under certain regulations.

articles.desc: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the government's commitment to increasing capital expenditure to promote economic growth. She remarked on the importance of fiscal prudence while implementing spending strategies effectively. Sitharaman emphasized the need for public investment to enhance welfare programs and improve access to essential services. The government aims to provide comprehensive insurance coverage by 2047 to foster financial inclusion.

articles.title: Capex key to India's growth strategy, fiscal prudence remains top priority: Sitharaman at HSBC event
articles.desc: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the importance of capital expenditure in driving economic growth in India. She stated that government spending would be guided by fiscal discipline while encouraging private sector investment. Sitharaman noted that higher public investment has historically generated strong economic returns over time. She reassured that the Indian economy remains robust, with no sign of fragility.

articles.title: Indians turn to side hustles, freelancing as non-salary income rises: ClearTax
articles.desc: Indians are increasingly earning from non-salary sources like trading and freelancing as reported by ClearTax. The percentage of self-filers reporting such income grew significantly from previous years. Data shows that young individuals are entering investment opportunities earlier than ever before. Additionally, women's participation in capital gains and higher income brackets has increased noticeably. This reflects a significant change in financial habits and diversification of income sources among taxpayers.

articles.desc: State Bank of India will announce Q2FY27 results on November 3, with brokerages forecasting 11-13% NII growth and up to 25.2% profit growth. Investors will track margins, loan growth, deposits, credit costs and asset quality.

articles.title: Ashish Kacholia-owned Knowledge Marine shares jump 4% on Rs 303 crore order win; stock up 67% in 2026
articles.desc: Knowledge Marine shares gained 4.17% after securing a Rs 303.17 crore, three-year maintenance dredging contract from New Mangalore Port Authority. The company also announced a November 6 record date for its five-for-one stock split.

articles.title: Keralam aims to bring in special Act to protect women from social media attacks
articles.desc: "The government is thinking of sending those who attack women on social media to prison by bringing in a special Act," CM V D Satheesan said while inaugurating 'Makalkoppam', a two-day seminar organised by the Women and Child Development Department to formulate a women's policy after discussions with various stakeholders.

articles.title: Rupee ends little changed as traders stay cautious despite oil, dollar drop
articles.desc: The Indian rupee closed at 94.90 per dollar, trimming its earlier advances. Despite lower oil prices and a softening dollar, the rupee struggled to gain ground as traders remained wary ahead of the impending US midterm elections. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India's increased dollar forward position suggests a possible dollar-buying approach. Overall, market sentiment reflects caution as global factors continue to influence local currency trends.

articles.title: Jailed PKK founder Ocalan moved to new section of Turkish island prison
articles.desc: Improving prison conditions for Abdullah Ocalan has been a key Kurdish demand in push to end PKK-Turkiye conflict.

articles.title: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surge 17% as Q2 FY 27 profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 21 crore
articles.desc: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surged nearly 17% after the company reported a 35.5% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit and 30.5% revenue growth. Strong pharma and FMCG packaging volumes supported performance, while new product launches and expansion plans strengthened its growth outlook.

articles.title: Global Market: French bond yields hold steady despite Fitch downgrade warning
articles.desc: French bond yields remained steady despite Fitch downgrading the country's outlook to negative, as investors weighed fiscal concerns and political uncertainty against easing energy prices and developments in the Middle East.

articles.title: Oyo parent PRISM clocks PAT of Rs 353 crore in Q1, up 17% YoY, revenue jumps 35%
articles.desc: Oyo parent PRISM reported a 35% YoY rise in Q1FY27 revenue to Rs 2,814 crore, while net profit grew 17% to Rs 353 crore. Gross Booking Value increased 30% to Rs 9,600 crore and EBITDA rose 24% to Rs 760 crore. Founder Ritesh Agarwal highlighted growth across hotels and vacation homes, technology investments and AI-led operational efficiencies.

articles.title: India’s manufacturing output dominated by large factories, while smaller units lag behind
articles.desc: India's manufacturing sector is highly fragmented, with large factories significantly outpacing small units in productivity and output. While large establishments employ most industrial workers and generate high GVA, smaller units remain burdened with debt. The productivity gap is exacerbated by limited access to technology and training for smaller factories. Additionally, women workers constitute a small fraction of the overall workforce in manufacturing.

articles.title: Japan bond yields edge higher ahead of key JGB auctions; 10-year yield holds at 2.77%
articles.desc: Japanese government bond yields were mixed on Monday, with the 10-year benchmark holding steady at 2.77%, while the 20-year and 30-year yields rose. Investors assessed global interest rate trends ahead of a series of government debt auctions, including a 10-year bond sale on Thursday, followed by 30-year and five-year auctions later this month.

articles.title: Indian IPO market clocks record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, fundraising jumps 30%
articles.desc: India's mainboard IPO market raised a record Rs 84,400 crore in H1 FY27, up 30% year-on-year, as September saw unprecedented fundraising. Strong investor participation, confidential filings and a robust pipeline supported primary market momentum.

articles.title: FIIs increase stake: 11 Nifty stocks rally up to 50% in FY27 so far
articles.desc: Foreign institutional investors raised their stakes in 19 Nifty 50 companies in the September 2026 quarter. Of these, 11 stocks have gained 10% to 50% in FY27 so far, reflecting strong price momentum alongside increased FII ownership.

articles.title: MobiKwik shares zoom 10% as fintech firm posts record Rs 12 crore profit in Q2
articles.desc: MobiKwik returned to profitability in Q2 FY27, reporting a record consolidated net profit of Rs 11.8 crore against a loss of Rs 28.6 crore a year earlier. Profit rose over 55% sequentially from Rs 7.6 crore in Q1 FY27, while revenue from operations increased 9% year-on-year to Rs 1,082.6 crore.

articles.desc: Drought and conflict compound the threat to wildlife in eastern DR Congo.

These proposals are designed to boost post-tax returns, particularly as market performance has been behind that of emerging counterparts. The current capital gains tax rates are seen as a hindrance, leading to demands for a review.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February
articles.desc: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.

articles.title: Trump set for midterm test: What's in store for India, Iran, Ukraine after November 4?

articles.title: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 12% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
articles.desc: Reliance Industries experienced a remarkable increase in share price after reporting impressive Q2 earnings, which significantly boosted its market capitalization. The firm’s net profit surged by 41% year-over-year, fueled by strong performances in its oil-to-chemicals and digital services segments. Analysts express optimism, with several brokerages setting ambitious target prices. Current technical indicators also reveal a favorable price trajectory, suggesting room for further growth following this positive oil sector performance.

articles.title: South Eastern Coalfields files DRHP with SEBI for IPO; Coal India to offload 66.8 crore shares

Despite cap rates hitting historic lows, the sector continues to offer double-digit unlevered returns over five years. With limited scope for further compression, future returns will increasingly depend on rental income growth and operational efficiencies.

articles.title: Bitcoin rattled by biggest crypto heist in history! Why Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger hated cryptocurrency
articles.desc: A reported $6 billion crypto heist at Binance has rattled investors and revived concerns about cryptocurrency risks. Binance said its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, which may have enabled unauthorised withdrawals. The FBI blamed North Korea for the attack, while Binance said it would cover the losses.

With revenues climbing by 10.4% to 15.19 billion rupees and expenses only rising 8.3%, Chairman Ravi Jaipuria emphasized the ongoing challenges posed by inflation and increasing interest rates.

EBITDA margin contracted to 3.1% from 7.1% a year ago, despite higher revenue and operating profit growth.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation ahead of December signing

Central to the talks were customs cooperation and trade facilitation, deemed critical for the agreement's efficacy. Additionally, industry stakeholders from the diamond sector were engaged to harness opportunities within India's expanding market.

articles.title: Apple Q4 earnings: 5 key things investors will watch
articles.desc: Apple’s fiscal fourth-quarter results will put early iPhone 18 demand, Services growth and holiday-quarter guidance in focus. Investors will also assess supply constraints, rising component costs and initial demand for the foldable iPhone Duo as the company delivers its first earnings presentation under new CEO John Ternus.

articles.title: India, EU discuss FTA implementation, customs cooperation and market access in Brussels
articles.desc: India and the European Union engaged in discussions regarding the implementation of their Free Trade Agreement. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held meetings with various senior European Commission officials in Brussels, focusing on market access and customs procedures. The FTA is expected to eliminate tariffs on the majority of exports from both regions. Both parties are working towards the proposed signing and full ratification of the agreement.

articles.title: Sebi backs removal of LTCG tax for foreign investors: Report
articles.desc: To boost foreign investment interest, India's Securities and Exchange Board has put forth a proposal to scrap long-term capital gains tax for foreign investors and extend tax relief to mutual fund investors. This move is designed to counteract the high capital gains taxes and transaction costs faced by foreign entities, aiming to enhance the overall attractiveness of India's equity market.

articles.title: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jump 14% in 2 days, m-cap swells by Rs 1,600 crore after Q2 results

articles.title: India bonds surge as oil cools on US-Iran deal hopes

The falling crude prices are expected to alleviate inflation concerns and fiscal pressures for India. Furthermore, the Reserve Bank of India may adjust its interest rate plans based on these developments.

articles.title: GAIL shares jump 4% as Q2 net profit rises over 8% to Rs 4,650 crore, revenue grows 17%

articles.desc: South Korean shares rose after early losses due to strong export data that improved investor sentiment. Analysts indicated that this performance might lead to upward revisions in corporate earnings forecasts. However, factory activity in South Korea expanded at its slowest pace in eight months.

articles.title: Reliance Industries shares skyrocket 12%, record biggest single-day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 2 lakh cr rally

The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

articles.title: US midterm elections begin tomorrow: Can Trump’s likely defeat sparkle Sensex, Nifty? Here’s what analysts say
articles.desc: The November 3 US midterm elections could reshape control of Congress, with analysts anticipating potential Republican losses. A divided government may heighten market volatility, although historical annualised returns remain largely unaffected. For Indian investors, the key concerns are the dollar, US bond yields, crude oil prices and foreign fund flows amid an already challenging market environment.

articles.title: Wall Street rushes in with bullish calls on India’s top bourse
articles.desc: Wall Street brokerages are turning bullish on NSE, citing its dominant market position and India’s expanding capital markets. Rising investor participation, trading activity and new businesses could drive long-term revenue and earnings growth.

articles.title: Apple's new CEO John Ternus to face first earnings test as memory costs surge

articles.title: India likely to meet FY27 fiscal deficit target despite spending pressures: Goldman Sachs
articles.desc: The Centre appears on track to meet the fiscal deficit target set for FY27. Strong corporate tax collections are offsetting some revenue pressures observed in the first half of the fiscal year. The government's fiscal position improved significantly in September compared to August, aided by higher direct tax revenues. Focused expenditure reallocation will be crucial in achieving the deficit goals.

articles.title: Fintechs fortify cyber defences; Logistics cos in the speed lane
articles.desc: Happy Monday! Fintechs are stepping up security as AI-powered cyberattacks become more sophisticated. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

articles.title: GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October as festive demand beats high inflation and interest rates
articles.desc: India's GST collections in October reached ₹2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a 22.9% year-on-year increase. Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments. Power consumption also surged nearly 22% compared to last year, further emphasizing economic strength. Despite a high inflation rate of 5.5%, demand has remained robust, supporting growth forecasts. Analysts suggest this growth aligns with leading indicators of a consumption-driven economy.

articles.title: One nation, many opportunities: Why India's many elections may be keeping protests peaceful
articles.desc: People across India are protesting peacefully, contrasting with violent agitations seen in other countries. The 'one nation, multiple elections' framework allows diverse political benefits to be shared among parties. This electoral model keeps governments accountable and responsive to public needs. Elections help to channel frustrations and enable citizens to express their concerns. As a result, the political landscape remains dynamic and participatory, fostering a sense of empowerment.

articles.title: PM Modi to meet Niti Aayog leadership on Nov 5; likely to  review  work as govt begins shaping  FY28 Budget
articles.desc: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to meet the new leadership of Niti Aayog on November 5. This meeting aims to establish budget priorities amidst global uncertainty and economic growth challenges. The focus will be on enhancing domestic manufacturing and creating employment opportunities. Experts from various sectors will provide insights related to India's development objectives.

articles.title: CII calls for GST-like reforms in land, labour & local approvals
articles.desc: CII has called for extending the GST Council's approach to decriminalise offences in various sectors. This move aims to enhance ease of doing business and attract investments in land, labour, and construction. The organisation emphasizes the importance of simplifying regulatory processes across different government tiers.
